what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission accepted a short sewer extension at 4 Kimball Street, on condition that a licensed contractor or drain layer is assigned.
The commission voted to abate past-due sewer bills at 24 John Street, following a Chapter 7 bankruptcy order of discharge.
The DPW director will prepare a short ARPA request for manhole and pump station work, for the Select Board meeting the following week.
The commission discussed a possible illegal connection at 400 Sunny Hill Road and asked that someone representing the property attend the next meeting.
Approval of the minutes was put off for lack of members who attended both meetings, and the business manager announced her retirement.

why_it_matters: The ARPA request, if the Select Board grants it, would pay for sewer manhole and pump station repairs from federal relief money rather than from sewer rates.
The commission also asked about a credit for indirect costs during the DPW director vacancy, a question of which budget carries staffing costs, and no vote was taken on it.
